purpose: Baseline-only class attribute export/consumer propagation evidence. No patch IDs, expected outcomes, or test-name rules used by tools.

schema: files[path].class_attribute_global_exports[qualname] = sorted attribute names; * means unresolved class-wide external read. Shared selector eligibility should reject narrowing only for affected attributes (or *).
limitations: Static class copies and known inheritance only; dynamic reference graphs are incomplete.
Lexical outer expansion is conservative supplemental evidence, not proof of all metaclass flows.
Module registry exports still require conservative fallback or a complete downstream dependency graph.
No existing consumer links were removed; no test outcomes or patch identities were used.
Static dependency graph is not complete for arbitrary Python reflection/imports/metaclasses. Absence of an export does not establish safety.
Same-receiver derivations can still escape transitively; lexicalouter propagation is conservative supplemental evidence.
